title: NHS trusts to be investigated over ‘repeated failures’ to admit treatment errors
summary_full: Failing in their legal duty of candour adds to the distress of patients and families and damages trust, says England’s public service ombudsmanHospitals will be investigated for regularly breaching their legal duty to tell patients and their relatives when mistakes have happened.The public service ombudsman for England is launching an investigation into “repeated failures” by NHS trusts to discharge their “duty of candour” to admit when treatment errors have led to patients dying or suffering harm.
